Usman vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Food ... on 4 July, 
2024 
Author: Sangeeta Chandra
Bench: Sangeeta Chandra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:45351-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 5769 of 2024
Petitioner :- Usman
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Food Safety Drug Admin. Govt. Lko.  And 3  Counsel for Petitioner :- Shikhar Chaube,Akshya Tiwari,Saurabh Singh Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Anil Kumar Tripathi Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents and Sri Anil Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel, who appears on behalf of respondent no. 3. 
This petition has been filed with the following main prayers:-
"(I). Issue a writ, order or direction in nature of mandamus commanding & directing the opposite party no. 4 to consider and decide the representation dated 11.03.2024,
Usman vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Food ... on 4 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81308140/
1 as contained in Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition, within a short and reasonable time as prescribed by this Hon'ble Court, in the interest of justice. 
(II). Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding &
directing the opposite parties/authorities concerned to grant, the petitioner, a license as a Food business Operator as provided under Regulation 2.1 (Chapter II) of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses)
Regulations, 2011 and allow the petitioner to operate his meat shop further commanding the opposite parties not to interfere/disturb in peaceful operation of the meat shop of the petitioner without following due procedure of law.
It is the case of the petitioner that petitioner has applied for license to run a meat shop for which NOC is required to be given by Superintendent of Police, Gonda/Station House Officer concerned. 
This writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to make a fresh fresh representation to the Superintendent of Police of the district concerned, who shall call for a report from the police station concerned and pass appropriate orders for grant of NOC, strictly in accordance with law, within a period of two weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before it. 
Order Date :- 4.7.2024 AKS  Usman vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Food ... on 4 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81308140/

summary.decision:
This petition has been filed with the following main prayers:-
"(I). Issue a writ, order or direction in nature of mandamus commanding & directing the opposite party no. 4 to consider and decide the representation dated 11.03.2024,

as contained in Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition, within a short and reasonable time as prescribed by this Hon'ble Court, in the interest of justice.

(II). Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding &
directing the opposite parties/authorities concerned to grant, the petitioner, a license as a Food business Operator as provided under Regulation 2.1 (Chapter II) of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses)
Regulations, 2011 and allow the petitioner to operate his meat shop further commanding the opposite parties not to interfere/disturb in peaceful operation of the meat shop of the petitioner without following due procedure of law.
It is the case of the petitioner that petitioner has applied for license to run a meat shop for which NOC is required to be given by Superintendent of Police, Gonda/Station House Officer concerned.

This writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to make a fresh fresh representation to the Superintendent of Police of the district concerned, who shall call for a report from the police station concerned and pass appropriate orders for grant of NOC, strictly in accordance with law, within a period of two weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before it.
